arxiv-1906-01839.title: How Many Impulses Redux
arxiv-1906-01839.creator: Ehsan Taheri, and John L. Junkins
arxiv-1906-01839.description: Abstract A central problem in orbit transfer optimization is to determine the number, time, direction and magnitude of velocity impulses that minimize the total impulse. This problem was posed in 1967 by T. N. Edelbaum, and while notable advances have been made, a rigorous means to answer Edelbaum’s question for multiple-revolution maneuvers has remained elusive for over five decades.

arxiv-1911-07558.title: Search for supersymmetry in pp collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV with 137 \fbinv in final states with a single lepton using the sum of masses of large-radius jets
arxiv-1911-07558.description: Abstract Results are reported from a search for new physics beyond the standard model in proton-proton collisions in final states with a single lepton; multiple jets, including at least one jet tagged as originating from the hadronization of a bottom quark; and large missing transverse momentum.

arxiv-2102-00187.title: Hořava-Lifshitz scalar field cosmology: classical and quantum viewpoints
arxiv-2102-00187.creator: Fatimah Tavakoli, Babak Vakili, Hossein Ardehali
arxiv-2102-00187.description: Abstract In this paper, we study a projectable Hořava-Lifshitz cosmology without the detailed balance condition minimally coupled to a non-linear self-coupling scalar field. In the minisuperspace framework, the super Hamiltonian of the presented model is constructed by means of which, some classical solutions for scale factor and scalar field are obtained.

arxiv-2103-06287.title: Robust Gapless Superconductivity in 4Hb-TaS 2
arxiv-2103-06287.creator: David Dentelski, Ezra Day-Roberts, Turan Birol, Rafael M. Fernandes, Jonathan Ruhman 1, 2
arxiv-2103-06287.description: Abstract The superconducting TMD 4Hb-TaS 2 consists of alternating layers of H and T structures, which in their bulk form are metallic and Mott-insulating, respectively. Recently, this compound has been proposed as a candidate chiral superconductor, due to an observed enhancement of the muon spin relaxation at T c T_{c} .

arxiv-2104-11903.title: Magnetoconductance modulations due to interlayer tunneling in radial superlattices
arxiv-2104-11903.creator: Yu-Jie Zhong 1,2, Angus Huang 3,4, Hui Liu 5, Xuan-Fu Huang 1, Horng-Tay Jeng 3,4,6, Jhih-Shih You 7, Carmine Ortix 8,9, Ching-Hao Chang 1,2∗
arxiv-2104-11903.description: Abstract Radial superlattices are nanostructured materials obtained by rolling-up thin solid films into spiral-like tubular structures. The formation of these “high-order” superlattices from two-dimensional crystals or ultrathin films is expected to result in a transition of transport characteristics from two-dimensional to one-dimensional.

arxiv-2205-09870.title: Searching for Muonphilic Dark Sectors with Proton Beams
arxiv-2205-09870.creator: Claudia Rella, Babette Döbrich, Tien-Tien Yu
arxiv-2205-09870.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Claudia Rella, Babette Döbrich, Tien-Tien Yu. Proton beam-dump experiments are a high-intensity source of secondary muons and provide an opportunity to probe muon-specific dark sectors. We adopt a simplified-models framework for an exotic light scalar particle coupling predominantly or exclusively to muons.

arxiv-2303-07952.title: The Riesz Transform and Fractional Integral Operators in the Bessel Setting
arxiv-2303-07952.creator: Jorge J. Betancor, Xuan Thinh Duong, Ming-Yi Lee, Ji Li, Brett D. Wick
arxiv-2303-07952.description: Abstract Abstract: Fix \lambda>0 . Consider the Bessel operator \triangle_{\lambda}:=-\frac{d^{2}}{dx^{2}}-\frac{2\lambda}{x}\frac{d}{dx} on \mathbb{R_{+}} , where \mathbb{R_{+}}:=(0,\infty) and dm_{\lambda}:=x^{2\lambda}dx with dx the Lebesgue measure. We provide a deeper study of the Bessel Riesz transform and fractional integral operator via the related Besov and Triebel–Lizorkin spaces associated with \triangle_{\lambda} .

pmc-10622397.description: Key Clinical messageNeostigmine and atropine offer a promising treatment option for postdural puncture headache (PDPH) following spinal anesthesia in cesarean section, providing effective relief with a favorable risk–benefit profile.AbstractPostdural puncture headache (PDPH) is a common consequence of cesarean section surgeries after spinal anesthesia. pmc-13263128.creator: Andy Kwok, Chris Selman, Kellie Gumm, David J Read, Ned Douglas, Elyssia M Bourke
pmc-13263128.description: ObjectiveHypocalcaemia is a common electrolyte disturbance in major trauma patients, particularly those with haemorrhagic shock. pmc-13286806.description: BackgroundAir pollution is associated with impaired oocyte and embryo development, but the modifying effects of large-scale societal disruptions remain unclear. The aim of this study was to examine whether in vitro fertilization (IVF)-related mature oocyte, fertilization, and pregnancy rates differ across the periods before, during, and after the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

pmc-13330581.title: Porous and luminescent Dy-doped Co-BTC MOFs for label-free detection of tetracycline and vanadium traces in water
pmc-13330581.creator: Karanveer Singh, M. Manolata Devi, Suvankar Chakraverty, Bhanu Prakash
pmc-13330581.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Continuous intake of antibiotic residues and trace heavy metals in food is a growing health concern that weakens immunity. Sensitive, selective detection methods are therefore essential, motivating the development of new sensing materials. The present study reports the synthesis of dysprosium (Dy)-doped cobalt (Co)-trimesic acid (BTC)-based luminescent metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) via a single-step solvothermal method and their utilization in detecting traces of antibiotics (ABx) and metal ions. Extensive microscopic studies have shown that the prepared MOFs exhibit a highly porous, spherical morphology.

pmc-13335692.title: Engineering of Crystal and Domain Structures in Epitaxial Y:HfO2 Thin Films by YSZ Substrate Miscut
pmc-13335692.creator: Jun Young Lee, Hyung‐Jin Choi, Kun Hee Ye, Haneul Choi, Byeong‐hyeon Lee, Min‐Seok Kim, Dong‐Hun Han, June Hyuk Lee, Sung Ok Won, Tae Heon Kim, Hye Jung Chang, Jung‐Hae Choi, Seung‐Hyub Baek
pmc-13335692.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The crystal and domain structures of epitaxial polymorphic oxide thin films are governed not only by intrinsic bulk energies but also by extrinsic factors arising from interactions with the underlying oxide substrates. Here, we investigate the effects of substrate miscut on the phase stability of epitaxial HfO2 films on yttria‐stabilized zirconia (Y:ZrO2, YSZ), employing a combined experimental and computational approach to map the thickness‐temperature phase diagram.

pmc-13359481.title: Introduction of Low‐Voltage Bridge Mapping for Radiofrequency Ablation of AVNRT in Children: One‐Year Follow‐Up Results
pmc-13359481.creator: Tomasz M. Książczyk, Klaudia Obsznajczyk, Radosław Pietrzak
pmc-13359481.description: BackgroundLow‐voltage bridge mapping (LVBM) is a recently introduced approach to atrioventricular nodal reentry tachycardia (AVNRT) ablation that may facilitate precise slow‐pathway targeting. Our center implemented LVBM for radiofrequency (RF) AVNRT ablation in children in April 2023. Early results demonstrated procedural advantages without prolonging procedure time.AimThe present study evaluates one‐year follow‐up outcomes after the introduction of LVBM.

pmc-13582946.description: Microtubule acetylation of lysine 40 of α-tubulin is a hallmark of stable microtubules. uslaw-usc-t8-s1531.title: 8 U.S.C. § 1531 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t8-s1531.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t8-s1531.description: United States Code, Title 8 (Aliens And Nationality); Chapter 12 (Immigration And Nationality); Subchapter V (Alien Terrorist Removal Procedures). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. As used in this subchapter— (1) the term “alien terrorist” means any alien described in section 1227(a)(4)(B) of this title; (2) the term “classified information” has the same meaning as in section 1(a) of the Classified Information Procedures.
